name: note-close-long
title: A long note, opened at its end, closed into its card (#322)
description: Design 5.5. A note of 40 lines opens with its caret at its end, scrolled there, so the line in sight at the top of the page is not its first. Closing, its words do not ride onto the card's title, which is another line: they fade from 140 ms in 80 ms (linear) while the page fades into the card from 140 ms (200 ms, standard). The card's slot shows words at every frame, and the page lands on its card.

movements.name: open
movements.description: The long note's card is pressed. On the mockup, which places no caret, its field is then scrolled to its end, where the app's caret puts it.

handsOver.because: design 5.5: a long note, scrolled to its end, does not ride onto its card's title, which is another line; its words fade from 140 ms in 80 ms as the page fades into the card. Judged without `line`: such a note fills its page with words, so the words part's box is words wherever the clip is, and its first line, which `line` follows, is scrolled out of sight
